Proposals cover project debt, cost overruns, any required equity contribution, and offtake and marketing; they remain indicative.
The breadth of interest gives the company options, but a preferred bidder shortlist and detailed negotiations are still pending.

A preferred-bidder shortlist, detailed negotiations, and a financing outcome would determine whether the proposals become a larger catalyst.
